<h1 id="misp-automation-api">MISP Automation API v2.5</h1>

> Scroll down for code samples, example requests and responses. Select a language for code samples from the tabs above or the mobile navigation menu.


### Getting Started

MISP API allows you to query, create, modify data models, such as [Events](https://www.circl.lu/doc/misp/GLOSSARY.html#misp-event),
[Objects](https://www.circl.lu/doc/misp/misp-objects/), [Attributes](https://www.circl.lu/doc/misp/GLOSSARY.html#misp-attribute).
This is extremely useful for interconnecting MISP with external tools and feeding other systems with threat intel data.

It also lets you perform administrative tasks such as creating users, organisations, altering MISP settings, and much more.

To get an API key there are several options:
* **[UI]** Go to [My Profile -> Auth Keys](/auth_keys/index) section and click on `+ Add authentication key`

* **[UI]** As an admin go to the [Administration -> List Users -> View](/admin/users/view/[id]) page of the user you want to create an auth key for and on the `Auth keys` section click on `+ Add authentication key`

* **[CLI]** Use the following command: `./app/Console/cake user change_authkey [e-mail/user_id]`

* **API** Provided you already have an admin level API key, you can create an API key for another user using the `[POST]/auth_keys/add/{{user_id}}` endpoint.

> **NOTE:** The authentication key will only be displayed once, so take note of it or store it properly in your application secrets.

#### Accept and Content-Type headers 
When performing your request, depending on the type of request, you might need to explicitly specify in what content 
type you want to get your results. This is done by setting one of the below `Accept` headers:

    Accept: application/json
    Accept: application/xml

When submitting data in a `POST`, `PUT` or `DELETE` operation you also need to specify in what content-type you encoded the payload. 
This is done by setting one of the below `Content-Type` headers:

    Content-Type: application/json
    Content-Type: application/xml

Example:
```
curl  --header "Authorization: YOUR_API_KEY" \
      --header "Accept: application/json" \
      --header "Content-Type: application/json" https://<misp url>/ 
```

> **NOTE**: By appending .json or .xml the content type can also be set without the need for a header.

#### Automation using PyMISP

[PyMISP](https://github.com/MISP/PyMISP) is a Python library to access MISP platforms via their REST [API](https://www.circl.lu/doc/misp/GLOSSARY.html#api).
It allows you to fetch events, add or update events/attributes, add or update samples or search for attributes.

### FAQ
* [Dev FAQ](https://www.circl.lu/doc/misp/dev-faq/)
* [GitHub project FAQ](https://github.com/MISP/MISP/wiki/Frequently-Asked-Questions)

Base URLs:

* <a href="https://misp.local">https://misp.local</a>

# Authentication

* API Key (ApiKeyAuth)
    - Parameter Name: **Authorization**, in: header. The authentication of the automation is performed via a secure key available in the MISP UI interface. 
Make sure you keep that key secret as it gives access to the entire database! The [API](https://www.circl.lu/doc/misp/GLOSSARY.html#api) 
key is available in the event actions menu under automation.

The authorization is performed by using the following header in the API requests:

    Authorization: YOUR_API_KEY
    
> **NOTE**: Since version 2.2 the usage of the authentication key in the URL is deprecated. 
  Instead, pass the auth key in an Authorization header in the request. The legacy option of having the auth key 
  in the URL is temporarily still supported but not recommended.

<h1 id="misp-automation-api-analyst-data">Analyst Data</h1>

Analyst Data allows analysts to share and add their own analysis to any MISP data having an UUID. They can be one of these three type: Analyst Note, Analyst Opinion or Analyst Relationship.

## Add analyst data

<a id="opIdaddAnalystData"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://misp.example.com/analystData/add/Note/c99506a6-1255-4b71-afa5-7b8ba48c3b1b/Attribute \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "note": "Provide more context",
    "language": "fr-BE",
    "note_type_name": "Note",
    "uuid": "c99506a6-1255-4b71-afa5-7b8ba48c3b1b",
    "object_uuid": "c99506a6-1255-4b71-afa5-7b8ba48c3b1b",
    "object_type": "Attribute",
    "authors": "john.doe@admin.test",
    "org_uuid": "c99506a6-1255-4b71-afa5-7b8ba48c3b1b",
    "orgc_uuid": "c99506a6-1255-4b71-afa5-7b8ba48c3b1b",
    "created": "2024-03-19 11:10:24",
    "modified": "2024-03-19 11:10:24",
    "distribution": "4",
    "sharing_group_id": "1",
    "locked": true
  }'
```

`POST /analystData/add/{analystType}/{analystObjectUUID}/{analystObjectType}`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "note": "Provide more context",
  "language": "fr-BE",
  "note_type_name": "Note",
  "uuid": "c99506a6-1255-4b71-afa5-7b8ba48c3b1b",
  "object_uuid": "c99506a6-1255-4b71-afa5-7b8ba48c3b1b",
  "object_type": "Attribute",
  "authors": "john.doe@admin.test",
  "org_uuid": "c99506a6-1255-4b71-afa5-7b8ba48c3b1b",
  "orgc_uuid": "c99506a6-1255-4b71-afa5-7b8ba48c3b1b",
  "created": "2024-03-19 11:10:24",
  "modified": "2024-03-19 11:10:24",
  "distribution": "4",
  "sharing_group_id": "1",
  "locked": true
}
```

<h3 id="add-analyst-data-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|analystType|path|[AnalystDataType](#schemaanalystdatatype)|true|Type of the analyst data.|
|analystObjectUUID|path|[UUID](#schemauuid)|true|Object UUID that has an analyst data|
|analystObjectType|path|[AnalystObjectType](#schemaanalystobjecttype)|true|Object type that has an analyst data|
|body|body|[AnalystNote](#schemaanalystnote) \| [AnalystOpinion](#schemaanalystopinion) \| [AnalystRelationship](#schemaanalystrelationship)|true|none|
|» *oneOf*|body|[AnalystNote](#schemaanalystnote)|false|none|
|» *oneOf*|body|[AnalystOpinion](#schemaanalystopinion)|false|none|
|» *oneOf*|body|[AnalystRelationship](#schemaanalystrelationship)|false|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|analystType|Note|
|analystType|Opinion|
|analystType|Relationship|
|analystObjectType|Attribute|
|analystObjectType|Event|
|analystObjectType|EventReport|
|analystObjectType|GalaxyCluster|
|analystObjectType|Galaxy|
|analystObjectType|Object|
|analystObjectType|Note|
|analystObjectType|Opinion|
|analystObjectType|Relationship|
|analystObjectType|Organisation|
|analystObjectType|SharingGroup|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "note": "Provide more context",
  "language": "fr-BE",
  "note_type_name": "Note",
  "uuid": "c99506a6-1255-4b71-afa5-7b8ba48c3b1b",
  "object_uuid": "c99506a6-1255-4b71-afa5-7b8ba48c3b1b",
  "object_type": "Attribute",
  "authors": "john.doe@admin.test",
  "org_uuid": "c99506a6-1255-4b71-afa5-7b8ba48c3b1b",
  "orgc_uuid": "c99506a6-1255-4b71-afa5-7b8ba48c3b1b",
  "created": "2024-03-19 11:10:24",
  "modified": "2024-03-19 11:10:24",
  "distribution": "4",
  "sharing_group_id": "1",
  "locked": true
}
```

> 403 Response

```json
{
  "name": "Authentication failed. Please make sure you pass the API key of an API enabled user along in the Authorization header.",
  "message": "Authentication failed. Please make sure you pass the API key of an API enabled user along in the Authorization header.",
  "url": "/attributes"
}
```

> default Response

```json

  "name": "string",
  "message": "string",
  "url": "/attributes"
}
```

|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|An analyst data. Could be a Note, Opinion or Relationship depending on the `analystType` parameter|Inline|
|403|Forbidden|Authentication failed. Please make sure you pass the API key of an API enabled user along in the Authorization header.|[UnauthorizedApiError](#schemaunauthorizedapierror)|
|default|Default|Unexpected API error|[ApiError](#schemaapierror)|

|*oneOf*|[AnalystOpinion](#schemaanalystopinion)|false|none|none|
|*oneOf*|[AnalystRelationship](#schemaanalystrelationship)|false|none|none|

To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:

  "url": "/attributes/1234"
}
```

> default Response

```json
{
  "name": "string",
  "message": "string",
  "url": "/attributes"
}
```

<h3 id="list-minimal-analyst-data-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|An list of Analyst Data UUIDs are the keys and their timestamp are in date format. Example: `{` `uuid`: `YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss` `}`.|Inline|
|403|Forbidden|Authentication failed. Please make sure you pass the API key of an API enabled user along in the Authorization header.|[UnauthorizedApiError](#schemaunauthorizedapierror)|
|404|Not Found|The specified resource was not found|[NotFoundApiError](#schemanotfoundapierror)|
|default|Default|Unexpected API error|[ApiError](#schemaapierror)|

<h3 id="list-minimal-analyst-data-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*oneOf*|[MinimalAnalystData](#schemaminimalanalystdata)|false|none|Minimal Analyst Data (notes, opinions and relationships).|
|*oneOf*|[MinimalAnalystDataEmpty](#schemaminimalanalystdataempty)|false|none|Minimal Analyst Data|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
ApiKeyAuth
</aside>

<h1 id="misp-automation-api-attributes">Attributes</h1>

Attributes in MISP can be network indicators (e.g. IP address), system indicators (e.g. a string in memory) or even bank account details.

<a href="https://www.circl.lu/doc/misp/GLOSSARY.html#misp-attribute">External documentation</a>

## [restSearch] Get a filtered and paginated list of attributes

<a id="opIdrestSearchAttributes"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://misp.example.com/attributes/restSearch \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "page": 1,
    "limit": 0,
    "value": "127.0.0.1",
    "value1": "127.0.0.1",
    "value2": "127.0.0.1",
    "type": "md5",
    "category": "Internal reference",
    "org": "12345",
    "tags": [
      "tlp:amber"
    ],
    "searchall": "malware",
    "from": "string",
    "to": "string",
    "last": 0,
    "eventid": "12345",
    "withAttachments": false,
    "uuid": "c99506a6-1255-4b71-afa5-7b8ba48c3b1b",
    "publish_timestamp": "1617875568",
    "published": false,
    "timestamp": "1617875568",
    "attribute_timestamp": "1617875568",
    "enforceWarninglist": true,
    "to_ids": true,
    "deleted": false,
    "event_timestamp": "1617875568",
    "threat_level_id": "1",
    "eventinfo": "string",
    "sharinggroup": [
      "1"
    ],
    "decayingModel": "string",
    "score": "string",
    "first_seen": "string",
    "last_seen": "string",
    "includeEventUuid": false,
    "includeEventTags": false,
    "includeProposals": false,
    "requested_attributes": [
      "id"
    ],
    "includeContext": true,
    "headerless": true,
    "includeWarninglistHits": true,
    "attackGalaxy": "mitre-attack",
    "object_relation": "filepath",
    "includeSightings": true,
    "includeCorrelations": true,
    "modelOverrides": {
      "lifetime": 3,
      "decay_speed": 2.3,
      "threshold": 30,
      "default_base_score": 80,
      "base_score_config": {
        "estimative-language:confidence-in-analytic-judgment": 0.25,
        "estimative-language:likelihood-probability": 0.25,
        "phishing:psychological-acceptability": 0.25,

      }
    },
    "includeDecayScore": false,

    "excludeDecayed": false,
    "returnFormat": "json"
  }'

<h3 id="restsearch-get-a-filtered-and-paginated-list-of-attributes-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[AttributeRestSearchFilter](#schemaattributerestsearchfilter)|true|none|
|» page|body|[PageSearchFilter](#schemapagesearchfilter)|false|none|
|» limit|body|[LimitSearchFilter](#schemalimitsearchfilter)|false|Maximum number of results to be returned. Can't be greater than the one set for your role. 0 means maximum.|
|» value|body|[AttributeValue](#schemaattributevalue)|false|none|
|» value1|body|[AttributeValue](#schemaattributevalue)|false|none|
|» value2|body|[AttributeValue](#schemaattributevalue)|false|none|
|» type|body|[AttributeType](#schemaattributetype)|false|none|
|» category|body|[AttributeCategory](#schemaattributecategory)|false|none|
|» org|body|[OrganisationId](#schemaorganisationid) \| [OrganisationName](#schemaorganisationname)|false|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[OrganisationId](#schemaorganisationid)|false|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[OrganisationName](#schemaorganisationname)|false|none|
|» tags|body|[TagsRestSearchFilter](#schematagsrestsearchfilter)|false|none|
|» searchall|body|[SearchAllRestSearchFilter](#schemasearchallrestsearchfilter)|false|Search events by matching any tag names, event descriptions, attribute values or attribute comments|
|» from|body|[DateRestSearchFilter](#schemadaterestsearchfilter)|false|You can use any of the valid time related filters (examples: 7d, timestamps, [14d, 7d] for ranges, etc.)|
|» to|body|[DateRestSearchFilter](#schemadaterestsearchfilter)|false|You can use any of the valid time related filters (examples: 7d, timestamps, [14d, 7d] for ranges, etc.)|
|» last|body|[LastRestSearchFilter](#schemalastrestsearchfilter)|false|Events published within the last x amount of time, where x can be defined in days, hours, minutes (for example 5d or 12h or 30m), ISO 8601 datetime format or timestamp|
|» eventid|body|[EventId](#schemaeventid)|false|none|
|» withAttachments|body|[WithAttachmentsRestSearchFilter](#schemawithattachmentsrestsearchfilter)|false|Extends the response with the base64 representation of the attachment, if there is one|
|» uuid|body|[UUID](#schemauuid)|false|none|
|» publish_timestamp|body|[Timestamp](#schematimestamp)|false|none|
|» published|body|[PublishedFlag](#schemapublishedflag)|false|none|
|» timestamp|body|[Timestamp](#schematimestamp)|false|none|
|» attribute_timestamp|body|[Timestamp](#schematimestamp)|false|none|
|» enforceWarninglist|body|[EnforceWarninglistRestSearchFilter](#schemaenforcewarninglistrestsearchfilter)|false|Should the warning list be enforced. Adds blocked field for matching attributes|
|» to_ids|body|[ToIDSRestSearchFlag](#schematoidsrestsearchflag)|false|none|
|» deleted|body|[SoftDeletedFlagValuesToInclude](#schemasoftdeletedflagvaluestoinclude)|false|Whether to include soft-deleted attributes. Default value 0. If set to 1, only deleted attributes will be returned. If set to [0,1], both deleted and non-deleted attributes will be returned.|
|» event_timestamp|body|[Timestamp](#schematimestamp)|false|none|
|» threat_level_id|body|[ThreatLevelId](#schemathreatlevelid)|false|Represents the threat level.<br>  * `1` - High<br>  * `2` - Medium<br>  * `3` - Low<br>  * `4` - Undefined<br>|
|» eventinfo|body|string|false|Quick event description|
|» sharinggroup|body|[SharingGroupIDRestSearchFilter](#schemasharinggroupidrestsearchfilter)|false|Sharing group ID(s), either as single string or list of IDs|
|» decayingModel|body|[DecayingModelRestSearchFilter](#schemadecayingmodelrestsearchfilter)|false|Specify the decaying model from which the decaying score should be calculated|
|» score|body|[DecayingModelScoreRestSearchFilter](#schemadecayingmodelscorerestsearchfilter)|false|An alias to override on-the-fly the threshold of the decaying model|
|» first_seen|body|string|false|Seen within the last x amount of time, where x can be defined in days, hours, minutes (for example 5d or 12h or 30m)|
|» last_seen|body|string|false|Seen within the last x amount of time, where x can be defined in days, hours, minutes (for example 5d or 12h or 30m)|
|» includeEventUuid|body|[IncludeEventUUIDRestSearchFlag](#schemaincludeeventuuidrestsearchflag)|false|Include matching eventUuids in the response|
|» includeEventTags|body|[IncludeEventTagsRestSearchFlag](#schemaincludeeventtagsrestsearchflag)|false|Include tags of matching events in the response|
|» includeProposals|body|[IncludeProposalsRestSearchFlag](#schemaincludeproposalsrestsearchflag)|false|Include proposals of matching events in the response|
|» requested_attributes|body|[RequestedAttributesRestSearchFilter](#schemarequestedattributesrestsearchfilter)|false|List of properties that will be selected in the CSV export|
|» includeContext|body|[IncludeContextRestSearchFlag](#schemaincludecontextrestsearchflag)|false|Adds events context fields in the CSV export|
|» headerless|body|[HeaderlessRestSearchFlag](#schemaheaderlessrestsearchflag)|false|Removes header in the CSV export|
|» includeWarninglistHits|body|[IncludeWarninglistHitsRestSearchFlag](#schemaincludewarninglisthitsrestsearchflag)|false|none|
|» attackGalaxy|body|[AttackGalaxyRestSearchFilter](#schemaattackgalaxyrestsearchfilter)|false|none|
|» object_relation|body|[ObjectRelationRestSearchFilter](#schemaobjectrelationrestsearchfilter)|false|Filter by the attribute object relation value|
|» includeSightings|body|[IncludeSightingDbRestSearchFlag](#schemaincludesightingdbrestsearchflag)|false|Extend response with Sightings DB results if the module is enabled|
|» includeCorrelations|body|[IncludeCorrelationsRestSearchFlag](#schemaincludecorrelationsrestsearchflag)|false|none|
|» modelOverrides|body|[DecayingModelParameters](#schemadecayingmodelparameters)|false|none|
|» includeDecayScore|body|[IncludeDecayScoreRestSearchFlag](#schemaincludedecayscorerestsearchflag)|false|Include all enabled decaying score|
|» includeFullModel|body|[IncludeFullModelRestSearchFlag](#schemaincludefullmodelrestsearchflag)|false|Include all model information of matching events in the response|
|» excludeDecayed|body|[ExcludeDecayedRestSearchFlag](#schemaexcludedecayedrestsearchflag)|false|Should the decayed elements by excluded|
|» returnFormat|body|[AttributesRestSearchReturnFormat](#schemaattributesrestsearchreturnformat)|false|Format of the response payload|

## Add tag(s) to attribute(s)

<a id="opIdtagAttribute"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://misp.example.com/attributes/addTag/string/string/local:0 \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "attribute": "12",
    "attribute_ids": "[\"1\",\"2\"]",
    "tag": "[\"tag\",\"1\",\"collection_1\"]"
  }'
```

`POST /attributes/addTag/{attributeId}/{tagId}/local:{local}`

Add one or multiple tags to one or multiple attributes

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "attribute": "12",
  "attribute_ids": "[\"1\",\"2\"]",
  "tag": "[\"tag\",\"1\",\"collection_1\"]"
}
```

<h3 id="add-tags-to-attributes-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|attributeId|path|string|true|Attribute ID or 'selected' to add tags to multiple attributes|
|tagId|path|string|true|Tag ID, tag name or tag collection ID (format collection_N)|
|local|path|integer|true|Whether to add tag as local tag (1) or global tag (0). Leave the other path params empty if you want to add local tags using the json request body params|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» attribute|body|string|false|Attribute ID when path param id is not set|
|» attribute_ids|body|string|false|JSON encoded array of attribute IDs when id is 'selected'|
|» tag|body|string|false|Tag ID/name or tag collection ID (format collection_N) when path param 'tagId' is not specified. This can also be a JSON encoded array of IDs/names and tag collection IDs to add multiple tags at once. Required if path param 'tagId' is not set|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|local|0|
|local|1|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "saved": true,
  "success": "Tag added.",
  "check_publish": true,
  "errors": "Tag could not be added."
}
```

> 403 Response

```json
{
  "name": "Authentication failed. Please make sure you pass the API key of an API enabled user along in the Authorization header.",
  "message": "Authentication failed. Please make sure you pass the API key of an API enabled user along in the Authorization header.",
  "url": "/attributes"
}
```

> 404 Response

```json
{
  "name": "Invalid attribute",
  "message": "Invalid attribute",
  "url": "/attributes/1234"
}
```

> default Response

```json
{
  "name": "string",
  "message": "string",
  "url": "/attributes"
}
```

<h3 id="add-tags-to-attributes-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Add attribute tag response|Inline|
|403|Forbidden|Authentication failed. Please make sure you pass the API key of an API enabled user along in the Authorization header.|[UnauthorizedApiError](#schemaunauthorizedapierror)|
|404|Not Found|The specified resource was not found|[NotFoundApiError](#schemanotfoundapierror)|
|default|Default|Unexpected API error|[ApiError](#schemaapierror)|

<h3 id="add-tags-to-attributes-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|saved|boolean|false|none|`true` if the tag was successfully added, `false` if it failed|
|success|string \| null|false|none|Present if the tag was successfully added|
|check_publish|boolean \| null|false|none|none|
|errors|string \| null|false|none|none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
ApiKeyAuth
</aside>

## Get attribute(s) by value

<a id="opIdgetAttributeByB64Value"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://misp.example.com/attributes/getAttributeByB64Value/MTkyLjE2OC4xLjE%3D \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /attributes/getAttributeByB64Value/{base64Value}`

Search for attributes by their value and return full attribute details including ID.
This endpoint allows efficient lookup of attributes directly in the database using indexed columns.
The attribute value must be base64 encoded in the URL path.

**Example usage:**
```bash
# Encode the attribute value to base64
VALUE="192.168.1.1"
BASE64=$(echo -n "$VALUE" | base64 -w0)

# Query the API
curl -H "Authorization: YOUR_API_KEY" \
     -H "Accept: application/json" \
     "https://misp.local/attributes/getid/${BASE64}"
```


<h3 id="get-attributes-by-value-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|base64Value|path|string(byte)|true|Base64 encoded attribute value to search for (use `echo -n 'value' \| base64 -w0`)|

<h1 id="misp-automation-api-collections">Collections</h1>

MISP collections can be used to organise data shared by the community. These collections can be categorised based on commonalities or as part of the research process.

## Add a collection

<a id="opIdaddCollection"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://misp.example.com/collections/add \
  -X POST \

<h1 id="misp-automation-api-events">Events</h1>

MISP events are encapsulations for contextually related information represented as attributes and objects.

<a href="https://www.circl.lu/doc/misp/GLOSSARY.html#misp-event">External documentation</a>

## [restSearch] Get a filtered and paginated list of events

<a id="opIdrestSearchEvents"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://misp.example.com/events/restSearch \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "page": 1,
    "limit": 0,
    "value": "127.0.0.1",
    "type": "md5",
    "category": "Internal reference",
    "org": "12345",
    "tags": [
      "tlp:amber"
    ],
    "event_tags": [
      "tlp:amber"
    ],
    "searchall": "malware",
    "from": "string",
    "to": "string",
    "last": 0,
    "eventid": "12345",
    "withAttachments": false,
    "sharinggroup": [
      "1"
    ],
    "metadata": true,
    "uuid": "c99506a6-1255-4b71-afa5-7b8ba48c3b1b",
    "publish_timestamp": "1617875568",
    "timestamp": "1617875568",
    "published": false,
    "enforceWarninglist": true,
    "sgReferenceOnly": true,
    "requested_attributes": [
      "id"
    ],
    "includeContext": true,
    "headerless": true,
    "includeWarninglistHits": true,
    "attackGalaxy": "mitre-attack",
    "to_ids": true,
    "deleted": false,
    "excludeLocalTags": true,
    "date": "string",
    "includeSightingdb": true,
    "tag": "tlp:white",
    "object_relation": "filepath",
    "threat_level_id": "1",
    "extending": true,
    "extended": true,
    "returnFormat": "json"
  }'
```

`POST /events/restSearch`

**This is the recommended endpoint for searching events.**


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "page": 1,
  "limit": 0,
  "value": "127.0.0.1",
  "type": "md5",
  "category": "Internal reference",
  "org": "12345",
  "tags": [
    "tlp:amber"
  ],
  "event_tags": [
    "tlp:amber"
  ],
  "searchall": "malware",
  "from": "string",
  "to": "string",
  "last": 0,
  "eventid": "12345",
  "withAttachments": false,
  "sharinggroup": [
    "1"
  ],
  "metadata": true,
  "uuid": "c99506a6-1255-4b71-afa5-7b8ba48c3b1b",
  "publish_timestamp": "1617875568",
  "timestamp": "1617875568",
  "published": false,
  "enforceWarninglist": true,
  "sgReferenceOnly": true,
  "requested_attributes": [
    "id"
  ],
  "includeContext": true,
  "headerless": true,
  "includeWarninglistHits": true,
  "attackGalaxy": "mitre-attack",
  "to_ids": true,
  "deleted": false,
  "excludeLocalTags": true,
  "date": "string",
  "includeSightingdb": true,
  "tag": "tlp:white",

  "threat_level_id": "1",
  "extending": true,
  "extended": true,
  "returnFormat": "json"
}
```

<h3 id="restsearch-get-a-filtered-and-paginated-list-of-events-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» page|body|[PageSearchFilter](#schemapagesearchfilter)|false|none|
|» limit|body|[LimitSearchFilter](#schemalimitsearchfilter)|false|Maximum number of results to be returned. Can't be greater than the one set for your role. 0 means maximum.|
|» value|body|[AttributeValue](#schemaattributevalue)|false|none|
|» type|body|[AttributeType](#schemaattributetype)|false|none|
|» category|body|[AttributeCategory](#schemaattributecategory)|false|none|
|» org|body|[OrganisationId](#schemaorganisationid) \| [OrganisationName](#schemaorganisationname)|false|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[OrganisationId](#schemaorganisationid)|false|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[OrganisationName](#schemaorganisationname)|false|none|
|» tags|body|[TagsRestSearchFilter](#schematagsrestsearchfilter)|false|none|
|» event_tags|body|[TagsRestSearchFilter](#schematagsrestsearchfilter)|false|none|
|» searchall|body|[SearchAllRestSearchFilter](#schemasearchallrestsearchfilter)|false|Search events by matching any tag names, event descriptions, attribute values or attribute comments|
|» from|body|[DateRestSearchFilter](#schemadaterestsearchfilter)|false|You can use any of the valid time related filters (examples: 7d, timestamps, [14d, 7d] for ranges, etc.)|
|» to|body|[DateRestSearchFilter](#schemadaterestsearchfilter)|false|You can use any of the valid time related filters (examples: 7d, timestamps, [14d, 7d] for ranges, etc.)|
|» last|body|[LastRestSearchFilter](#schemalastrestsearchfilter)|false|Events published within the last x amount of time, where x can be defined in days, hours, minutes (for example 5d or 12h or 30m), ISO 8601 datetime format or timestamp|
|» eventid|body|[EventId](#schemaeventid)|false|none|
|» withAttachments|body|[WithAttachmentsRestSearchFilter](#schemawithattachmentsrestsearchfilter)|false|Extends the response with the base64 representation of the attachment, if there is one|
|» sharinggroup|body|[SharingGroupIDRestSearchFilter](#schemasharinggroupidrestsearchfilter)|false|Sharing group ID(s), either as single string or list of IDs|
|» metadata|body|[MetadataRestSearchFilter](#schemametadatarestsearchfilter)|false|Will only return the metadata of the given query scope, contained data is omitted.|
|» uuid|body|[UUID](#schemauuid)|false|none|
|» publish_timestamp|body|[Timestamp](#schematimestamp)|false|none|
|» timestamp|body|[Timestamp](#schematimestamp)|false|none|
|» published|body|[PublishedFlag](#schemapublishedflag)|false|none|
|» enforceWarninglist|body|[EnforceWarninglistRestSearchFilter](#schemaenforcewarninglistrestsearchfilter)|false|Should the warning list be enforced. Adds blocked field for matching attributes|
|» sgReferenceOnly|body|boolean|false|Will only return the sharing group ID|
|» requested_attributes|body|[RequestedAttributesRestSearchFilter](#schemarequestedattributesrestsearchfilter)|false|List of properties that will be selected in the CSV export|
|» includeContext|body|[IncludeContextRestSearchFlag](#schemaincludecontextrestsearchflag)|false|Adds events context fields in the CSV export|
|» headerless|body|[HeaderlessRestSearchFlag](#schemaheaderlessrestsearchflag)|false|Removes header in the CSV export|
|» includeWarninglistHits|body|[IncludeWarninglistHitsRestSearchFlag](#schemaincludewarninglisthitsrestsearchflag)|false|none|
|» attackGalaxy|body|[AttackGalaxyRestSearchFilter](#schemaattackgalaxyrestsearchfilter)|false|none|
|» to_ids|body|[ToIDS](#schematoids)|false|none|
|» deleted|body|[SoftDeletedFlagValuesToInclude](#schemasoftdeletedflagvaluestoinclude)|false|Whether to include soft-deleted attributes. Default value 0. If set to 1, only deleted attributes will be returned. If set to [0,1], both deleted and non-deleted attributes will be returned.|
|» excludeLocalTags|body|[ExcludeLocalTagsRestSearchFilter](#schemaexcludelocaltagsrestsearchfilter)|false|Exclude local tags from the export|
|» date|body|[DateRestSearchFilter](#schemadaterestsearchfilter)|false|You can use any of the valid time related filters (examples: 7d, timestamps, [14d, 7d] for ranges, etc.)|
|» includeSightingdb|body|[IncludeSightingDbRestSearchFlag](#schemaincludesightingdbrestsearchflag)|false|Extend response with Sightings DB results if the module is enabled|
|» tag|body|[TagName](#schematagname)|false|none|
|» object_relation|body|[ObjectRelationRestSearchFilter](#schemaobjectrelationrestsearchfilter)|false|Filter by the attribute object relation value|
|» threat_level_id|body|[ThreatLevelId](#schemathreatlevelid)|false|Represents the threat level.<br>  * `1` - High<br>  * `2` - Medium<br>  * `3` - Low<br>  * `4` - Undefined<br>|
|» extending|body|[ExtendingRestSearchFlag](#schemaextendingrestsearchflag)|false|Whether to include events that are extending another one. If set to 1, only events extending another will be returned. If set to 0, only events that are not extending another will be returned. Omit or [0,1] to disregard extension state.|
|» extended|body|[ExtendedRestSearchFlag](#schemaextendedrestsearchflag)|false|Whether to include events that are extended by another one. If set to 1, only events extended by another will be returned. If set to 0, only events that are not extended by another will be returned. Omit or [0,1] to disregard extension state.|
|» returnFormat|body|[EventsRestSearchReturnFormat](#schemaeventsrestsearchreturnformat)|false|Format of the response payload|

## Add event

<a id="opIdaddEvent"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://misp.example.com/events/add \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "org_id": "12345",
    "distribution": "4",
    "info": "logged source ip",
    "orgc_id": "12345",
    "uuid": "c99506a6-1255-4b71-afa5-7b8ba48c3b1b",
    "date": "1991-01-15",
    "published": false,
    "analysis": "0",
    "attribute_count": "321",
    "timestamp": "1617875568",
    "sharing_group_id": "1",
    "proposal_email_lock": true,
    "locked": true,
    "threat_level_id": "1",
    "publish_timestamp": "1617875568",
    "sighting_timestamp": "1617875568",
    "disable_correlation": false,
    "extends_uuid": "c99506a6-1255-4b71-afa5-7b8ba48c3b1b",
    "event_creator_email": "user@example.com"
  }'
```

<h3 id="add-event-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[EventNoId](#schemaeventnoid)|true|none|
|» org_id|body|[OrganisationId](#schemaorganisationid)|false|none|
|» distribution|body|[DistributionLevelId](#schemadistributionlevelid)|false|Who will be able to see this event once it becomes published and eventually when it becomes pulled:<br>  * `0` - Your organization only<br>  * `1` - This community only<br>  * `2` - Connected communities<br>  * `3` - All communities<br>  * `4` - Sharing group<br>  * `5` - Inherit Event<br>|
|» info|body|[EventInfo](#schemaeventinfo)|false|none|
|» orgc_id|body|[OrganisationId](#schemaorganisationid)|false|none|
|» uuid|body|[UUID](#schemauuid)|false|none|
|» date|body|string|false|none|
|» published|body|[PublishedFlag](#schemapublishedflag)|false|none|
|» analysis|body|[AnalysisLevelId](#schemaanalysislevelid)|false|Represents the analysis maturity level.<br>  * `0` - Initial<br>  * `1` - Ongoing<br>  * `2` - Complete<br>|
|» attribute_count|body|[EventAttributeCount](#schemaeventattributecount)|false|none|
|» timestamp|body|[NullableTimestamp](#schemanullabletimestamp)|false|none|
|» sharing_group_id|body|[SharingGroupId](#schemasharinggroupid)|false|none|
|» proposal_email_lock|body|[EventProposalEmailLock](#schemaeventproposalemaillock)|false|none|
|» locked|body|[IsLocked](#schemaislocked)|false|none|
|» threat_level_id|body|[ThreatLevelId](#schemathreatlevelid)|false|Represents the threat level.<br>  * `1` - High<br>  * `2` - Medium<br>  * `3` - Low<br>  * `4` - Undefined<br>|
|» publish_timestamp|body|[Timestamp](#schematimestamp)|false|none|
|» sighting_timestamp|body|[Timestamp](#schematimestamp)|false|none|
|» disable_correlation|body|[DisableCorrelationFlag](#schemadisablecorrelationflag)|false|none|
|» extends_uuid|body|[ExtendsUUID](#schemaextendsuuid)|false|none|
|» event_creator_email|body|string(email)|false|none|

<h3 id="add-event-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|A freshly created event|[EditedEvent](#schemaeditedevent)|
|403|Forbidden|Authentication failed. Please make sure you pass the API key of an API enabled user along in the Authorization header.|[UnauthorizedApiError](#schemaunauthorizedapierror)|
|default|Default|Unexpected API error|[ApiError](#schemaapierror)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
ApiKeyAuth
</aside>

## Edit event

<a id="opIdeditEvent"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://misp.example.com/events/edit/12345 \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "org_id": "12345",
    "distribution": "4",
    "info": "logged source ip",
    "orgc_id": "12345",
    "uuid": "c99506a6-1255-4b71-afa5-7b8ba48c3b1b",
    "date": "1991-01-15",
    "published": false,
    "analysis": "0",
    "attribute_count": "321",
    "timestamp": "1617875568",
    "sharing_group_id": "1",
    "proposal_email_lock": true,
    "locked": true,
    "threat_level_id": "1",
    "publish_timestamp": "1617875568",
    "sighting_timestamp": "1617875568",
    "disable_correlation": false,
    "extends_uuid": "c99506a6-1255-4b71-afa5-7b8ba48c3b1b",
    "event_creator_email": "user@example.com"
  }'
```

`PUT /events/edit/{eventId}`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "org_id": "12345",
  "distribution": "4",
  "info": "logged source ip",
  "orgc_id": "12345",
  "uuid": "c99506a6-1255-4b71-afa5-7b8ba48c3b1b",
  "date": "1991-01-15",
  "published": false,
  "analysis": "0",
  "attribute_count": "321",
  "timestamp": "1617875568",
  "sharing_group_id": "1",
  "proposal_email_lock": true,
  "locked": true,
  "threat_level_id": "1",
  "publish_timestamp": "1617875568",
  "sighting_timestamp": "1617875568",
  "disable_correlation": false,
  "extends_uuid": "c99506a6-1255-4b71-afa5-7b8ba48c3b1b",
  "event_creator_email": "user@example.com"
}
```

<h3 id="edit-event-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|eventId|path|[EventId](#schemaeventid) \| [UUID](#schemauuid)|true|UUID or numeric ID of the event|
|body|body|[EventNoId](#schemaeventnoid)|true|none|
|» org_id|body|[OrganisationId](#schemaorganisationid)|false|none|
|» distribution|body|[DistributionLevelId](#schemadistributionlevelid)|false|Who will be able to see this event once it becomes published and eventually when it becomes pulled:<br>  * `0` - Your organization only<br>  * `1` - This community only<br>  * `2` - Connected communities<br>  * `3` - All communities<br>  * `4` - Sharing group<br>  * `5` - Inherit Event<br>|
|» info|body|[EventInfo](#schemaeventinfo)|false|none|
|» orgc_id|body|[OrganisationId](#schemaorganisationid)|false|none|
|» uuid|body|[UUID](#schemauuid)|false|none|
|» date|body|string|false|none|
|» published|body|[PublishedFlag](#schemapublishedflag)|false|none|
|» analysis|body|[AnalysisLevelId](#schemaanalysislevelid)|false|Represents the analysis maturity level.<br>  * `0` - Initial<br>  * `1` - Ongoing<br>  * `2` - Complete<br>|
|» attribute_count|body|[EventAttributeCount](#schemaeventattributecount)|false|none|
|» timestamp|body|[NullableTimestamp](#schemanullabletimestamp)|false|none|
|» sharing_group_id|body|[SharingGroupId](#schemasharinggroupid)|false|none|
|» proposal_email_lock|body|[EventProposalEmailLock](#schemaeventproposalemaillock)|false|none|
|» locked|body|[IsLocked](#schemaislocked)|false|none|
|» threat_level_id|body|[ThreatLevelId](#schemathreatlevelid)|false|Represents the threat level.<br>  * `1` - High<br>  * `2` - Medium<br>  * `3` - Low<br>  * `4` - Undefined<br>|
|» publish_timestamp|body|[Timestamp](#schematimestamp)|false|none|
|» sighting_timestamp|body|[Timestamp](#schematimestamp)|false|none|
|» disable_correlation|body|[DisableCorrelationFlag](#schemadisablecorrelationflag)|false|none|
|» extends_uuid|body|[ExtendsUUID](#schemaextendsuuid)|false|none|
|» event_creator_email|body|string(email)|false|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» distribution|0|
|» distribution|1|
|» distribution|2|
|» distribution|3|
|» distribution|4|
|» distribution|5|
|» analysis|0|
|» analysis|1|
|» analysis|2|
|» threat_level_id|1|
|» threat_level_id|2|
|» threat_level_id|3|
|» threat_level_id|4|

## Delete event

<a id="opIddeleteEvent"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://misp.example.com/events/delete/12345 \
  -X DELETE \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`DELETE /events/delete/{eventId}`

<h3 id="delete-event-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|eventId|path|[EventId](#schemaeventid) \| [UUID](#schemauuid)|true|UUID or numeric ID of the event|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "saved": true,
  "success": true,
  "name": "Event deleted.",
  "message": "Could not delete Event",
  "url": "/events/delete/1",
  "errors": "Event was not deleted."
}
```

> 403 Response

```json
{
  "name": "Authentication failed. Please make sure you pass the API key of an API enabled user along in the Authorization header.",
  "message": "Authentication failed. Please make sure you pass the API key of an API enabled user along in the Authorization header.",
  "url": "/attributes"
}
```

> default Response

```json
{
  "name": "string",
  "message": "string",
  "url": "/attributes"
}
```

<h3 id="delete-event-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Delete event response|Inline|
|403|Forbidden|Authentication failed. Please make sure you pass the API key of an API enabled user along in the Authorization header.|[UnauthorizedApiError](#schemaunauthorizedapierror)|
|default|Default|Unexpected API error|[ApiError](#schemaapierror)|

<h3 id="delete-event-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|saved|boolean|false|none|`true` if the event was successfully deleted, `false` if it failed|
|success|boolean \| null|false|none|`true` if the event was successfully deleted, `false` if it failed|
|name|string|false|none|none|
|message|string|false|none|none|
|url|string|false|none|none|
|errors|string \| null|false|none|Only present if an error occurred when deleting the event|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
ApiKeyAuth
</aside>

## Search events

<a id="opIdsearchEvents"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://misp.example.com/events/index \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "page": 1,
    "limit": 0,
    "sort": "timestamp",
    "direction": "asc",
    "minimal": false,
    "attribute": "covert channel",
    "eventid": "12345",
    "datefrom": "2021-03-05",
    "dateuntil": "2021-03-05",
    "org": "CIRCL",
    "eventinfo": "Phishing campaign",
    "tag": "tlp:white",
    "tags": [
      "tlp:amber",
      "cycat:scope=\"exploit\""
    ],
    "distribution": "4",
    "sharinggroup": "1",
    "analysis": "0",
    "threatlevel": "1",
    "extending": true,
    "extended": true,
    "email": "admin@admin.test",
    "hasproposal": "1",
    "timestamp": "1",
    "publish_timestamp": "1",
    "searchDatefrom": "2020-01-20",
    "searchDateuntil": "2020-01-20"
  }'
```

`POST /events/index`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "page": 1,
  "limit": 0,
  "sort": "timestamp",
  "direction": "asc",
  "minimal": false,
  "attribute": "covert channel",
  "eventid": "12345",
  "datefrom": "2021-03-05",
  "dateuntil": "2021-03-05",
  "org": "CIRCL",
  "eventinfo": "Phishing campaign",
  "tag": "tlp:white",
  "tags": [
    "tlp:amber",
    "cycat:scope=\"exploit\""
  ],
  "distribution": "4",
  "sharinggroup": "1",
  "analysis": "0",
  "threatlevel": "1",
  "extending": true,
  "extended": true,
  "email": "admin@admin.test",
  "hasproposal": "1",
  "timestamp": "1",
  "publish_timestamp": "1",
  "searchDatefrom": "2020-01-20",
  "searchDateuntil": "2020-01-20"
}
```

<h3 id="search-events-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» page|body|[PageSearchFilter](#schemapagesearchfilter)|false|none|
|» limit|body|[LimitSearchFilter](#schemalimitsearchfilter)|false|Maximum number of results to be returned. Can't be greater than the one set for your role. 0 means maximum.|
|» sort|body|[SortSearchField](#schemasortsearchfield)|false|Field to be used to sort the result|
|» direction|body|[DirectionSearchField](#schemadirectionsearchfield)|false|Sort direction of the result|
|» minimal|body|boolean \| null|false|Returns a minimal version of the event, only events with `attributeCount` > 0 will be returned|
|» attribute|body|string \| null|false|Filter events matching the given string with attributes values|
|» eventid|body|[EventId](#schemaeventid)|false|none|
|» datefrom|body|string(date) \| null|false|Event creation date is greater or equal|
|» dateuntil|body|string(date) \| null|false|Event creation date is less or equal|
|» org|body|string \| null|false|Filter events by matching the creator organisation name|
|» eventinfo|body|string \| null|false|Filter events by matching the event info text|
|» tag|body|[TagName](#schematagname)|false|none|
|» tags|body|[[TagName](#schematagname)]|false|Filter events by matching *any* of the event tags of a given list of tag names|
|» distribution|body|[DistributionLevelId](#schemadistributionlevelid)|false|Who will be able to see this event once it becomes published and eventually when it becomes pulled:<br>  * `0` - Your organization only<br>  * `1` - This community only<br>  * `2` - Connected communities<br>  * `3` - All communities<br>  * `4` - Sharing group<br>  * `5` - Inherit Event<br>|
|» sharinggroup|body|[SharingGroupId](#schemasharinggroupid)|false|none|
|» analysis|body|[AnalysisLevelId](#schemaanalysislevelid)|false|Represents the analysis maturity level.<br>  * `0` - Initial<br>  * `1` - Ongoing<br>  * `2` - Complete<br>|
|» threatlevel|body|[ThreatLevelId](#schemathreatlevelid)|false|Represents the threat level.<br>  * `1` - High<br>  * `2` - Medium<br>  * `3` - Low<br>  * `4` - Undefined<br>|
|» extending|body|[ExtendingRestSearchFlag](#schemaextendingrestsearchflag)|false|Whether to include events that are extending another one. If set to 1, only events extending another will be returned. If set to 0, only events that are not extending another will be returned. Omit or [0,1] to disregard extension state.|
|» extended|body|[ExtendedRestSearchFlag](#schemaextendedrestsearchflag)|false|Whether to include events that are extended by another one. If set to 1, only events extended by another will be returned. If set to 0, only events that are not extended by another will be returned. Omit or [0,1] to disregard extension state.|
|» email|body|string(email) \| null|false|Filter events by matching the event creator user email|
|» hasproposal|body|string \| null|false|Filter events by checking if it has attributes with change proposals. Possible values: `0`, `1`|
|» timestamp|body|string \| null|false|Event timestamp greater or equal|
|» publish_timestamp|body|string \| null|false|Event publish timestamp greater or equal|
|» searchDatefrom|body|string \| null|false|Filters on the date, anything newer than the given date in YYYY-MM-DD format is taken - non-negatable|
|» searchDateuntil|body|string \| null|false|Filters on the date, anything older than the given date in YYYY-MM-DD format is taken - non-negatable|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» direction|asc|
|» direction|desc|
|» distribution|0|
|» distribution|1|
|» distribution|2|
|» distribution|3|
|» distribution|4|
|» distribution|5|
|» analysis|0|
|» analysis|1|
|» analysis|2|
|» threatlevel|1|
|» threatlevel|2|
|» threatlevel|3|
|» threatlevel|4|

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|saved|boolean|false|none|`true` if the tag was successfully added, `false` if it failed|
|success|string \| null|false|none|Present if the tag was successfully added|
|check_publish|boolean \| null|false|none|none|
|errors|string \| null|false|none|none|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
ApiKeyAuth
</aside>

## Remove event tag

<a id="opIduntagEvent"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://misp.example.com/events/removeTag/12345/12345 \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`POST /events/removeTag/{eventId}/{tagId}`

<h3 id="remove-event-tag-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|eventId|path|[EventId](#schemaeventid) \| [UUID](#schemauuid)|true|UUID or numeric ID of the event|
|tagId|path|[TagId](#schematagid)|true|Numeric ID of the attribute|

> Example responses

  "errors": "Tag could not be added."
}
```

> 403 Response

```json
{
  "name": "Authentication failed. Please make sure you pass the API key of an API enabled user along in the Authorization header.",
  "message": "Authentication failed. Please make sure you pass the API key of an API enabled user along in the Authorization header.",
  "url": "/attributes"
}
```

> default Response

```json
{
  "name": "string",
  "message": "string",
  "url": "/attributes"
}
```

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Remove event tag response|Inline|
|403|Forbidden|Authentication failed. Please make sure you pass the API key of an API enabled user along in the Authorization header.|[UnauthorizedApiError](#schemaunauthorizedapierror)|
|default|Default|Unexpected API error|[ApiError](#schemaapierror)|

<h3 id="remove-event-tag-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|

|success|string \| null|false|none|Present if the tag was successfully added|
|check_publish|boolean \| null|false|none|none|
|errors|string \| null|false|none|none|

<h1 id="misp-automation-api-galaxies">Galaxies</h1>

Galaxies in MISP are a method used to express a large object called cluster that can be attached to MISP events or attributes.

<a href="https://www.circl.lu/doc/misp/galaxy/">External documentation</a>

## Get galaxies

<a id="opIdgetGalaxies"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://misp.example.com/galaxies \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"

May be provided as a single distribution ID or as a list of IDs. When a list is provided, clusters matching any of the given distribution levels are returned. <h1 id="misp-automation-api-servers">Servers</h1>

Servers represent MISP instances we are connected to and from which we can pull/push data from/to.

<a href="https://www.circl.lu/doc/misp/sharing/">External documentation</a>

## Add server

<a id="opIdaddServer"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://misp.example.com/servers/add \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "name": "Phishing Server",
    "url": "https://misppriv.circl.lu",
    "authkey": "894c8d095180c7ea28789092e96ca6424199aa4f",
    "org_id": "12345",

    "pull": true,
    "push_sightings": true,
    "push_galaxy_clusters": true,
    "pull_galaxy_clusters": true,

    "lastpushedid": "12345",
    "organization": "string",
    "remote_org_id": "12345",
    "publish_without_email": true,
    "unpublish_event": true,
    "self_signed": true,
    "pull_rules": "{\"tags\":{\"OR\":[],\"NOT\":[]},\"orgs\":{\"OR\":[],\"NOT\":[]},\"url_params\":\"\"}",
    "push_rules": "{\"tags\":{\"OR\":[],\"NOT\":[]},\"orgs\":{\"OR\":[],\"NOT\":[]}}",
    "cert_file": "string",

    "cache_timestamp": true
  }'
```

<h1 id="misp-automation-api-sharing-groups">Sharing Groups</h1>

Sharing groups in MISP are a more granular way to create re-usable distribution lists for events/attributes that allow users to include organisations from their own instance (local organisations) as well as organisations from directly, or indirectly connected instances (external organisations).

<a href="https://www.circl.lu/doc/misp/sharing/#sharing-groups">External documentation</a>

## Add a sharing group

<a id="opIdaddSharingGroup"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://misp.example.com/sharing_groups/add \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "uuid": "c99506a6-1255-4b71-afa5-7b8ba48c3b1b",
    "name": "Banking Sharing Group",
    "description": "Banking Institutions of X Sharing Group",
    "releasability": "string",
    "local": true,
    "active": true,
    "org_count": "6",
    "organisation_uuid": "c99506a6-1255-4b71-afa5-7b8ba48c3b1b",
    "org_id": "12345",
    "sync_user_id": "12345",
    "created": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
    "modified": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
    "roaming": true
  }'
```

<h1 id="misp-automation-api-sharing-group-blueprints">Sharing Group Blueprints</h1>

Sharing group blueprints allow a user to programmatically define reusable blueprints for generating sharing groups, based on inheritance and various filters.

<a href="https://www.misp-project.org/2022/03/02/MISP.2.4.154.released.html/">External documentation</a>

## Add a sharing group blueprint

<a id="opIdaddSharingGroupBlueprint"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://misp.example.com/sharing_group_blueprints/add \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "SharingGroupBlueprint": {
      "name": "string",
      "rules": "{\"AND\":{\"OR\":{\"org_id\":[1,2],\"org_uuid\":[\"3e0d3fc7-972a-4788-9161-cc250df116f9\",\"26f07156-948c-4b7f-ac2c-921e29a319b4\"],\"org_name\":\"Example name\",\"org_sector\":\"Example sector\",\"org_type\":\"Example Type\",\"sharing_group_id\":5,\"sharing_group_uuid\":\"bc8cd878-c22e-400b-892a-e204d5f1d4bd\",\"org_nationality\":[\"Example nationality 1\",\"Example nationality 2\"]},\"NOT\":{\"org_nationality\":[\"Example nationality a\",\"Example nationality b\"]}}}",
      "sharing_group_id": "1"
    }
  }'
```

`POST /sharing_group_blueprints/add`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "SharingGroupBlueprint": {
    "name": "string",
    "rules": "{\"AND\":{\"OR\":{\"org_id\":[1,2],\"org_uuid\":[\"3e0d3fc7-972a-4788-9161-cc250df116f9\",\"26f07156-948c-4b7f-ac2c-921e29a319b4\"],\"org_name\":\"Example name\",\"org_sector\":\"Example sector\",\"org_type\":\"Example Type\",\"sharing_group_id\":5,\"sharing_group_uuid\":\"bc8cd878-c22e-400b-892a-e204d5f1d4bd\",\"org_nationality\":[\"Example nationality 1\",\"Example nationality 2\"]},\"NOT\":{\"org_nationality\":[\"Example nationality a\",\"Example nationality b\"]}}}",
    "sharing_group_id": "1"
  }
}
```

<h3 id="add-a-sharing-group-blueprint-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[SharingGroupBlueprintAdd](#schemasharinggroupblueprintadd)|true|none|
|» SharingGroupBlueprint|body|object|false|none|
|» » name|body|string|false|none|
|» » rules|body|string|false|String encoded JSON. Supported operands are OR, AND and NOT. Supported filters, as single values or list, are: org_id, org_uuid, org_name, org_nationality, org_sector, org_type, sharing_group_id and sharing_group_uuid.|
|» » sharing_group_id|body|[SharingGroupIntId](#schemasharinggroupintid)|false|none|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "SharingGroupBlueprint": {
    "id": "1",
    "uuid": "c99506a6-1255-4b71-afa5-7b8ba48c3b1b",
    "name": "string",
    "timestamp": "1617875568",
    "user_id": "12345",
    "org_id": "12345",
    "sharing_group_id": "1",
    "rules": "{\"AND\":{\"OR\":{\"org_id\":[1,2],\"org_uuid\":[\"3e0d3fc7-972a-4788-9161-cc250df116f9\",\"26f07156-948c-4b7f-ac2c-921e29a319b4\"],\"org_name\":\"Example name\",\"org_sector\":\"Example sector\",\"org_type\":\"Example Type\",\"sharing_group_id\":5,\"sharing_group_uuid\":\"bc8cd878-c22e-400b-892a-e204d5f1d4bd\",\"org_nationality\":[\"Example nationality 1\",\"Example nationality 2\"]},\"NOT\":{\"org_nationality\":[\"Example nationality a\",\"Example nationality b\"]}}}"
  }
}
```

> default Response

```json
{
  "name": "string",
  "message": "string",
  "url": "/attributes"
}
```

<h3 id="add-a-sharing-group-blueprint-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Sharing group blueprint response|Inline|
|default|Default|Unexpected API error|[ApiError](#schemaapierror)|

<h3 id="add-a-sharing-group-blueprint-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|

<h1 id="misp-automation-api-feeds">Feeds</h1>

Feeds are remote or local resources containing indicators that can be automatically imported into MISP at regular intervals. Feeds can be structured in [MISP format](https://www.circl.lu/doc/misp/GLOSSARY.html#misp-format), CSV format or even free-text format.

<a href="https://www.circl.lu/doc/misp/managing-feeds/#feeds">External documentation</a>

<h1 id="misp-automation-api-objects">Objects</h1>

MISP objects are in addition to MISP attributes to allow advanced combinations and concatenation of attributes. The creation of these objects and their associated attributes are based on real cyber security use-cases and existing practices in information sharing.

<a href="https://www.circl.lu/doc/misp/misp-objects/">External documentation</a>

    "value": "127.0.0.1",
    "type": "md5",
    "category": "Internal reference",
    "object_relation": "filepath",
    "attribute_timestamp": "1617875568",

    "includeAllTags": false,
    "includeEventUuid": false,
    "include_event_uuid": false,
    "includeEventTags": false,

    "includeContext": true,

## Add an object to an event

<a id="opIdaddObject"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://misp.example.com/objects/add/12345/12345 \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "Attribute": [
      {
        "category": "Internal reference",
        "value": "127.0.0.1",
        "to_ids": true,
        "disable_correlation": false,
        "distribution": "4",
        "comment": "logged source ip",
        "object_relation": "sensor"
      }
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /objects/add/{eventId}/{objectTemplateId}`

|body|body|object|false|none|

<h1 id="misp-automation-api-sightings">Sightings</h1>

Sightings is a system allowing people to react on attributes on an event. It was originally designed to provide an easy method for user to tell when they see a given attribute, giving it more credibility.

<a href="https://www.circl.lu/doc/misp/sightings/">External documentation</a>

<h1 id="misp-automation-api-warninglists">Warninglists</h1>

<a href="https://www.circl.lu/doc/misp/warninglists/">External documentation</a>

<h1 id="misp-automation-api-logs">Logs</h1>

Users with audit permissions are able to browse or search logs that MISP automatically appends each time certain actions are taken (actions that modify data or if a user logs in and out).

<a href="https://www.circl.lu/doc/misp/administration/#using-misp-logs">External documentation</a>

## Get instance logs

<a id="opIdgetLogs"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://misp.example.com/admin/logs \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "page": 1,
    "limit": 0,
    "id": "12345",
    "title": "Attribute (448272) from Event (1): Other/text foo",
    "created": "string",
    "model": "AdminSetting",
    "model_id": "12345",
    "action": "accept",
    "user_id": "12345",
    "change": "%name () => (ORGNAME)%",
    "email": "user@example.com",
    "org": "ORG_%",
    "description": "%updated by User%",
    "ip": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /admin/logs`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "page": 1,
  "limit": 0,
  "id": "12345",
  "title": "Attribute (448272) from Event (1): Other/text foo",
  "created": "string",
  "model": "AdminSetting",
  "model_id": "12345",
  "action": "accept",
  "user_id": "12345",
  "change": "%name () => (ORGNAME)%",
  "email": "user@example.com",
  "org": "ORG_%",
  "description": "%updated by User%",
  "ip": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="get-instance-logs-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» page|body|[PageSearchFilter](#schemapagesearchfilter)|false|none|
|» limit|body|[LimitSearchFilter](#schemalimitsearchfilter)|false|Maximum number of results to be returned. Can't be greater than the one set for your role. 0 means maximum.|
|» id|body|[LogId](#schemalogid)|false|none|
|» title|body|[LogTitle](#schemalogtitle)|false|none|
|» created|body|[DateRestSearchFilter](#schemadaterestsearchfilter) \| [DateIntervalRestSearchFilter](#schemadateintervalrestsearchfilter)|false|none|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[DateRestSearchFilter](#schemadaterestsearchfilter)|false|You can use any of the valid time related filters (examples: 7d, timestamps, [14d, 7d] for ranges, etc.)|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[DateIntervalRestSearchFilter](#schemadateintervalrestsearchfilter)|false|Interval described by two dates|
|» model|body|[ModelName](#schemamodelname)|false|none|
|» model_id|body|[ModelId](#schemamodelid)|false|none|
|» action|body|[LogActionType](#schemalogactiontype)|false|none|
|» user_id|body|[UserId](#schemauserid)|false|none|
|» change|body|string|false|Text search for log change property|
|» email|body|string(email)|false|none|
|» org|body|string|false|Text search for log organisation name property|
|» description|body|string|false|Text search for log change property|
|» ip|body|string|false|Text search for log ip property|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» model|AdminSetting|
|» model|Allowedlist|
|» model|AttachmentScan|
|» model|Attribute|
|» model|AttributeTag|
|» model|AuditLog|
|» model|AuthKey|
|» model|Bruteforce|
|» model|Cerebrate|
|» model|Community|
|» model|CorrelationExclusion|
|» model|Correlation|
|» model|Dashboard|
|» model|DecayingModelMapping|
|» model|DecayingModel|
|» model|EventBlocklist|
|» model|EventDelegation|
|» model|EventGraph|

<h1 id="misp-automation-api-authkeys">AuthKeys</h1>

AuthKeys are used to authenticate MISP API requests. AuthKeys can be set to read-only, a single user can have multiple auth keys.

<a href="https://www.circl.lu/doc/misp/automation/#automation-key">External documentation</a>

## Get auth keys

<a id="opIdgetAuthKeys"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://misp.example.com/auth_keys \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /auth_keys`

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
[
  {
    "AuthKey": {
      "id": "12345",
      "uuid": "c99506a6-1255-4b71-afa5-7b8ba48c3b1b",
      "authkey_start": "stri",
      "authkey_end": "stri",
      "created": "1617875568",
      "expiration": "1970-01-01 00:00:00",
      "read_only": true,
      "user_id": "12345",
      "comment": "string",
      "allowed_ips": [
        "127.0.0.1"
      ],
      "last_used": "1617875568"
    },
    "User": {
      "id": "12345",
      "email": "user@example.com"
    }
  }
]
```

> 403 Response

```json
{
  "name": "Authentication failed. Please make sure you pass the API key of an API enabled user along in the Authorization header.",
  "message": "Authentication failed. Please make sure you pass the API key of an API enabled user along in the Authorization header.",
  "url": "/attributes"
}
```

> 404 Response

```json
{
  "name": "Invalid attribute",
  "message": "Invalid attribute",
  "url": "/attributes/1234"
}
```

> default Response

```json
{
  "name": "string",
  "message": "string",
  "url": "/attributes"
}
```

|---|---|---|---|

|default|Default|Unexpected API error|[ApiError](#schemaapierror)|

## Search auth keys

<a id="opIdsearchAuthKeys"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://misp.example.com/auth_keys \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "page": 1,
    "limit": 0,
    "id": "12345",
    "uuid": "c99506a6-1255-4b71-afa5-7b8ba48c3b1b",
    "authkey_start": "string",
    "authkey_end": "string",
    "created": "string",
    "expiration": "string",
    "read_only": true,
    "user_id": "12345",
    "comment": "string",
    "allowed_ips": "[\"127.0.0.1\",\"127.0.0.2\"]",
    "last_used": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /auth_keys`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "page": 1,
  "limit": 0,
  "id": "12345",
  "uuid": "c99506a6-1255-4b71-afa5-7b8ba48c3b1b",
  "authkey_start": "string",
  "authkey_end": "string",
  "created": "string",
  "expiration": "string",
  "read_only": true,
  "user_id": "12345",
  "comment": "string",
  "allowed_ips": "[\"127.0.0.1\",\"127.0.0.2\"]",
  "last_used": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="search-auth-keys-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» page|body|[PageSearchFilter](#schemapagesearchfilter)|false|none|
|» limit|body|[LimitSearchFilter](#schemalimitsearchfilter)|false|Maximum number of results to be returned. Can't be greater than the one set for your role. 0 means maximum.|
|» id|body|[AuthKeyId](#schemaauthkeyid)|false|none|
|» uuid|body|[UUID](#schemauuid)|false|none|
|» authkey_start|body|string|false|Search term matching the first 4 characters of the authkey|
|» authkey_end|body|string|false|Search term matching the last 4 characters of the authkey|
|» created|body|[DateRestSearchFilter](#schemadaterestsearchfilter)|false|You can use any of the valid time related filters (examples: 7d, timestamps, [14d, 7d] for ranges, etc.)|
|» expiration|body|[DateRestSearchFilter](#schemadaterestsearchfilter)|false|You can use any of the valid time related filters (examples: 7d, timestamps, [14d, 7d] for ranges, etc.)|
|» read_only|body|[IsReadOnly](#schemaisreadonly)|false|none|
|» user_id|body|[UserId](#schemauserid)|false|none|
|» comment|body|string|false|none|
|» allowed_ips|body|string|false|Stringified JSON array of the IP addresses.|
|» last_used|body|[DateRestSearchFilter](#schemadaterestsearchfilter)|false|You can use any of the valid time related filters (examples: 7d, timestamps, [14d, 7d] for ranges, etc.)|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
[
  {
    "AuthKey": {
      "id": "12345",
      "uuid": "c99506a6-1255-4b71-afa5-7b8ba48c3b1b",
      "authkey_start": "stri",
      "authkey_end": "stri",
      "created": "1617875568",
      "expiration": "1970-01-01 00:00:00",

      "user_id": "12345",
      "comment": "string",

        "127.0.0.1"
      ],
      "last_used": "1617875568"

    }
  }
]
```

  "name": "Authentication failed. Please make sure you pass the API key of an API enabled user along in the Authorization header.",

  "url": "/attributes"

## Add auth keys

<h1 id="misp-automation-api-taxonomies">Taxonomies</h1>

MISP Taxonomies is a set of common classification libraries to tag, classify and organise information. Taxonomy allows to express the same vocabulary among a distributed set of users and organisations.

<a href="https://www.circl.lu/doc/misp/taxonomy/#taxonomies">External documentation</a>

  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"

<h1 id="misp-automation-api-event-report">Event Report</h1>

    "name": "Report of the incident",
    "content": "string",
    "distribution": "4",
    "sharing_group_id": "1",
    "timestamp": "1617875568",
    "deleted": false
  }'
```

  "name": "Report of the incident",
  "content": "string",

## Restore Event Report

<a id="opIdrestoreEventReport"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://misp.example.com/eventReports/restore/12345 \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`POST /eventReports/restore/{eventReportId}`

<h3 id="restore-event-report-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|eventReportId|path|[EventReportId](#schemaeventreportid) \| [UUID](#schemauuid)|true|UUID or numeric ID of the event report|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "saved": true,
  "success": true,
  "name": "Event report 1 restored.",
  "message": "Event Report 1 could not be restored. Reasons: Errors",
  "url": "/eventReport/restore/1",
  "errors": "Event Report was not restored."
}
```

> 403 Response

```json
{
  "name": "Authentication failed. Please make sure you pass the API key of an API enabled user along in the Authorization header.",
  "message": "Authentication failed. Please make sure you pass the API key of an API enabled user along in the Authorization header.",
  "url": "/attributes"
}
```

> default Response

```json
{
  "name": "string",
  "message": "string",
  "url": "/attributes"
}
```

<h3 id="restore-event-report-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Restore Event Report response|Inline|
|403|Forbidden|Authentication failed. Please make sure you pass the API key of an API enabled user along in the Authorization header.|[UnauthorizedApiError](#schemaunauthorizedapierror)|
|default|Default|Unexpected API error|[ApiError](#schemaapierror)|

<h3 id="restore-event-report-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|saved|boolean|false|none|`true` if the event was successfully deleted, `false` if it failed|
|success|boolean \| null|false|none|`true` if the event was successfully deleted, `false` if it failed|
|name|string|false|none|none|
|message|string|false|none|none|
|url|string|false|none|none|
|errors|string \| null|false|none|Only present if an error occurred when deleting the event|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
ApiKeyAuth
</aside>

## Import Report From URL

<a id="opIdimportFromURLEventReport"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://misp.example.com/eventReports/importReportFromUrl/12345 \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "url": "https://domain.example/blogpost/123.pdf"
  }'
```

`POST /eventReports/importReportFromUrl/{eventId}`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "url": "https://domain.example/blogpost/123.pdf"
}
```

<h3 id="import-report-from-url-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|eventId|path|[EventId](#schemaeventid) \| [UUID](#schemauuid)|true|UUID or numeric ID of the event|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» url|body|string|false|none|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "saved": true,
  "success": true,
  "name": "Event report imported",
  "message": "Report downloaded and created",
  "url": "/eventReport/importReportFromUrl/1",
  "errors": "Could not fetch report from URL. Fetcher module not enabled or could not download the page"
}
```

> 403 Response

```json
{
  "name": "Authentication failed. Please make sure you pass the API key of an API enabled user along in the Authorization header.",
  "message": "Authentication failed. Please make sure you pass the API key of an API enabled user along in the Authorization header.",
  "url": "/attributes"
}
```

> default Response

```json
{
  "name": "string",
  "message": "string",
  "url": "/attributes"
}
```

<h3 id="import-report-from-url-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Import from URL Event Report response|Inline|
|403|Forbidden|Authentication failed. Please make sure you pass the API key of an API enabled user along in the Authorization header.|[UnauthorizedApiError](#schemaunauthorizedapierror)|
|default|Default|Unexpected API error|[ApiError](#schemaapierror)|

<h3 id="import-report-from-url-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|saved|boolean|false|none|`true` if the event report was successfully created, `false` if it failed|
|success|boolean \| null|false|none|`true` if the event report was successfully created, `false` if it failed|
|name|string|false|none|none|
|message|string|false|none|none|
|url|string|false|none|none|
|errors|string \| null|false|none|Only present if an error occurred when deleting the event|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
ApiKeyAuth
</aside>

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|page|[PageSearchFilter](#schemapagesearchfilter)|false|none|none|
|limit|[LimitSearchFilter](#schemalimitsearchfilter)|false|none|Maximum number of results to be returned. Can't be greater than the one set for your role. 0 means maximum.|
|value|[AttributeValue](#schemaattributevalue)|false|none|none|
|value1|[AttributeValue](#schemaattributevalue)|false|none|none|
|value2|[AttributeValue](#schemaattributevalue)|false|none|none|
|type|[AttributeType](#schemaattributetype)|false|none|none|
|category|[AttributeCategory](#schemaattributecategory)|false|none|none|
|org|[OrganisationId](#schemaorganisationid) \| [OrganisationName](#schemaorganisationname)|false|none|none|
|tags|[TagsRestSearchFilter](#schematagsrestsearchfilter)|false|none|none|
|searchall|[SearchAllRestSearchFilter](#schemasearchallrestsearchfilter)|false|none|Search events by matching any tag names, event descriptions, attribute values or attribute comments|
|from|[DateRestSearchFilter](#schemadaterestsearchfilter)|false|none|You can use any of the valid time related filters (examples: 7d, timestamps, [14d, 7d] for ranges, etc.)|
|to|[DateRestSearchFilter](#schemadaterestsearchfilter)|false|none|You can use any of the valid time related filters (examples: 7d, timestamps, [14d, 7d] for ranges, etc.)|
|last|[LastRestSearchFilter](#schemalastrestsearchfilter)|false|none|Events published within the last x amount of time, where x can be defined in days, hours, minutes (for example 5d or 12h or 30m), ISO 8601 datetime format or timestamp|
|eventid|[EventId](#schemaeventid)|false|none|none|
|withAttachments|[WithAttachmentsRestSearchFilter](#schemawithattachmentsrestsearchfilter)|false|none|Extends the response with the base64 representation of the attachment, if there is one|
|uuid|[UUID](#schemauuid)|false|none|none|
|publish_timestamp|[Timestamp](#schematimestamp)|false|none|none|
|published|[PublishedFlag](#schemapublishedflag)|false|none|none|
|timestamp|[Timestamp](#schematimestamp)|false|none|none|
|attribute_timestamp|[Timestamp](#schematimestamp)|false|none|none|
|enforceWarninglist|[EnforceWarninglistRestSearchFilter](#schemaenforcewarninglistrestsearchfilter)|false|none|Should the warning list be enforced. Adds blocked field for matching attributes|
|to_ids|[ToIDSRestSearchFlag](#schematoidsrestsearchflag)|false|none|none|
|deleted|[SoftDeletedFlagValuesToInclude](#schemasoftdeletedflagvaluestoinclude)|false|none|Whether to include soft-deleted attributes. Default value 0. If set to 1, only deleted attributes will be returned. If set to [0,1], both deleted and non-deleted attributes will be returned.|
|event_timestamp|[Timestamp](#schematimestamp)|false|none|none|
|threat_level_id|[ThreatLevelId](#schemathreatlevelid)|false|none|Represents the threat level.<br>  * `1` - High<br>  * `2` - Medium<br>  * `3` - Low<br>  * `4` - Undefined<br>|
|eventinfo|string|false|none|Quick event description|
|sharinggroup|[SharingGroupIDRestSearchFilter](#schemasharinggroupidrestsearchfilter)|false|none|Sharing group ID(s), either as single string or list of IDs|
|decayingModel|[DecayingModelRestSearchFilter](#schemadecayingmodelrestsearchfilter)|false|none|Specify the decaying model from which the decaying score should be calculated|
|score|[DecayingModelScoreRestSearchFilter](#schemadecayingmodelscorerestsearchfilter)|false|none|An alias to override on-the-fly the threshold of the decaying model|
|first_seen|string|false|none|Seen within the last x amount of time, where x can be defined in days, hours, minutes (for example 5d or 12h or 30m)|
|last_seen|string|false|none|Seen within the last x amount of time, where x can be defined in days, hours, minutes (for example 5d or 12h or 30m)|
|includeEventUuid|[IncludeEventUUIDRestSearchFlag](#schemaincludeeventuuidrestsearchflag)|false|none|Include matching eventUuids in the response|
|includeEventTags|[IncludeEventTagsRestSearchFlag](#schemaincludeeventtagsrestsearchflag)|false|none|Include tags of matching events in the response|
|includeProposals|[IncludeProposalsRestSearchFlag](#schemaincludeproposalsrestsearchflag)|false|none|Include proposals of matching events in the response|
|requested_attributes|[RequestedAttributesRestSearchFilter](#schemarequestedattributesrestsearchfilter)|false|none|List of properties that will be selected in the CSV export|
|includeContext|[IncludeContextRestSearchFlag](#schemaincludecontextrestsearchflag)|false|none|Adds events context fields in the CSV export|
|headerless|[HeaderlessRestSearchFlag](#schemaheaderlessrestsearchflag)|false|none|Removes header in the CSV export|
|includeWarninglistHits|[IncludeWarninglistHitsRestSearchFlag](#schemaincludewarninglisthitsrestsearchflag)|false|none|none|
|attackGalaxy|[AttackGalaxyRestSearchFilter](#schemaattackgalaxyrestsearchfilter)|false|none|none|
|object_relation|[ObjectRelationRestSearchFilter](#schemaobjectrelationrestsearchfilter)|false|none|Filter by the attribute object relation value|
|includeSightings|[IncludeSightingDbRestSearchFlag](#schemaincludesightingdbrestsearchflag)|false|none|Extend response with Sightings DB results if the module is enabled|
|includeCorrelations|[IncludeCorrelationsRestSearchFlag](#schemaincludecorrelationsrestsearchflag)|false|none|none|
|modelOverrides|[DecayingModelParameters](#schemadecayingmodelparameters)|false|none|none|
|includeDecayScore|[IncludeDecayScoreRestSearchFlag](#schemaincludedecayscorerestsearchflag)|false|none|Include all enabled decaying score|
|includeFullModel|[IncludeFullModelRestSearchFlag](#schemaincludefullmodelrestsearchflag)|false|none|Include all model information of matching events in the response|
|excludeDecayed|[ExcludeDecayedRestSearchFlag](#schemaexcludedecayedrestsearchflag)|false|none|Should the decayed elements by excluded|
|returnFormat|[AttributesRestSearchReturnFormat](#schemaattributesrestsearchreturnformat)|false|none|Format of the response payload|
